name: Yajuu Kyoushi
source:
At a certain private school, the tuition is high and the education is decent. If there are serious students, delinquents are also present.
The protagonist is a new appointed teacher.

With her flashy clothes and rude behavior, the students look at her with awe rather than admiration.
Thanks to her father being a respected figure of the Board of Education and her grandfather being a powerful local politician, she doesn't have to worry about being fired.

The principal doesn't want to be involved with anything, the vice president is a doormat, and the nagging year-head teacher treats her appropriately.

What about you take a quick look at the routine (?) of that woman?

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=686835]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
某所私立学校学费高昂，教育水准也不错。这里既有认真学习的学生，也有不良少年少女。
主人公是一名新任教师。

她衣着花哨，言行粗鲁，学生们对她更多是畏惧而非敬仰。
父亲是教育委员会备受尊敬的人物，祖父则是地方上权势显赫的政治家，因此她不必担心被解雇。

校长不愿卷入任何麻烦，副校长唯唯诺诺，爱唠叨的年级主任则敷衍地应付她。

不妨来看看那个女人的日常（？）吧。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=686835]Getchu[/url]]
